title: Quotient of a Cohen–Macaulay local ring by a nonzerodivisor is Cohen–Macaulay
statement: Let $(S,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of Krull dimension $d=\dim S$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (finite, as $S$ is Noetherian local), and assume that $S$ is Cohen–Macaulay in the sense that $\operatorname{depth}(S)\ge d$ [def-weil-pbc-depth], that is, $\mathfrak m$ contains an $S$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] of length $d$. Let $x\in\mathfrak m$ be a nonzerodivisor on $S$. Then $S/xS$ is a Noetherian local ring of Krull dimension $\dim(S/xS)=d-1$, and it is Cohen–Macaulay in the same sense: $\operatorname{depth}(S/xS)\ge d-1$, i.e. the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m/xS$ of $S/xS$ contains an $S/xS$-regular sequence of length $d-1$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 02JN (lemma-reformulate-CM, line 25319), last assertion with c = 1 ('each quotient R/(x_1,...,x_i) is a Cohen-Macaulay ring of dimension dim(R) - i'), the hypothesis that x_1 is a regular sequence being equivalent there to dim R/x_1R = dim R - 1; a special case of Proposition Tag 00N6 (proposition-CM-module, line 25052) and Lemma lemma-CM-one-g (line 25018)

proof.text: The principal ideal (x) is contained in the maximal ideal. Apply Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff and IsLocalRing.of_surjective' to give Q=S/(x) its nonzero local structure; the quotient is Noetherian by the standard Mathlib quotient instance. IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective identifies its maximal ideal with the image of the maximal ideal of S.

source.place: Tags 02JN and 00FN, quotient by one regular element and Noetherian permanence; local quotient structure as in Section 07BH

proof.text: Apply the dimension-quotient-nonzerodivisor lemma to obtain dim(Q)+1=d. Nontriviality of Q excludes bottom. The successor equality with the given finite d excludes infinity. Write dim(Q) as a natural number n using WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists and ENat.ne_top_iff_exists; cast the successor equality to n+1=d, obtaining n=d-1 and d>=1.

source.place: Tag 00KW (lemma-one-equation), applied in the one-element case of Tag 02JN

proof.text: Apply depth_le_supportDim to S as an S-module and rewrite its support dimension by Mathlib Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim. The bound is depth(S)<=d; combine with the hypothesis d<=depth(S) to obtain depth(S)=d.

source.place: Tag 00LK (lemma-bound-depth), with M=S; Tag 02JN, Cohen-Macaulay hypothesis

proof.text: Convert x in nonZeroDivisors S to IsSMulRegular S x with Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors. Apply depth_quotSMulTop_of_isSMulRegular to M=S. Its natural-number depth e equals d by the preceding equality. Identify x times the top submodule of S with Ideal.span {x} using Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul and Ideal.smul_top_eq_map. Hence depth over S of Q is d-1.

Every element of (x) annihilates Q: on representatives its product with a class is zero by Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and ideal absorption. Use depth_over_quotient_ring with I=(x) and M=Q to identify its depth as a Q-module with its depth as an S-module. Therefore depth_Q(Q)=d-1.

source.place: Tag 0AUK (lemma-depth-goes-down-finite), quotient-map case; this gives the change of rings used in Tag 02JN

proof.text: Nakayama gives maximalIdeal(Q) times Q not equal to Q, so unfold the depth definition as the supremum of regular-sequence lengths in maximalIdeal(Q). This set is nonempty because the empty sequence is regular on the nonzero ring Q. Its supremum equals the finite natural number d-1, hence is attained by ENat.sSup_mem_of_nonempty_of_lt_top. Extract the list, its regularity and maximal-ideal membership, and cast the equality of its length to obtain length=d-1. Combine with the Noetherian, local, dimension and maximal-ideal facts.

lean.statement: theorem depth_quotient_nonzerodivisor (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim S = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (hdepth : (d : ℕ∞) ≤ depth (R := S) S) (x : S) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal S) (hregular : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors S) : ∃ hQ : IsLocalRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}), letI := hQ IsNoetherianRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧ ringKrullDim (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = ((d - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = (maximalIdeal S).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) ∧ ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ depth (R := S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧ ∃ rs : List (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}), RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) rs ∧ (∀ y ∈ rs, y ∈ maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) ∧ rs.length = d - 1
